name: QGVE Study A0 v3
description: Software and reproducibility artefact for Study A0 accompanying the manuscript “Quality-Governed Vibe Engineering: Intent Resolution and Deployment Discipline”. Version 3 removes the earlier span-length construction artefact by using coherent five-span specifications, overlapping ambiguous/unambiguous length distributions, an explicit OTHER class, and stronger abstention baselines. The package contains the frozen synthetic design and SHA-256, executable CPU-only analysis, 32 held-out coherent specifications (160 spans; 32 deliberately ambiguous), strong abstention baselines including entropy, split conformal, and a length-only heuristic, a 10,000-replication budget-matched random gate, clarification-success sensitivity, machine-readable results, and the exact Figure 2 source image. The benchmark is synthetic and provides mechanism-feasibility evidence rather than human validation.
